SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.path, m.component, m.visible,
IFNULL(m.perms, '') AS perms,
m.type, m.icon, m.sort FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.`visible` = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.sort

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.parent_id, m.name, m.path, m.component, m.visible,
IFNULL(m.perms, '') AS perms,
m.type, m.icon, m.sort FROM `sys_user_role` ur LEFT JOIN `sys_role_menu` rm ON ur.`role_id` = rm.`role_id` LEFT JOIN `sys_menu` m ON m.`id` = rm.`menu_id` WHERE ur.`user_id` = #{userId} AND m.`visible` = 1 AND m.`del_flag` = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort

SELECT distinct m.perms FROM sys_user_role ur LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{id} AND m.type = 4 AND m.`visible` = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0
